whyItMatters: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a profile repository URL over cleartext.
actions: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a profile repository URL over cleartext.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm settings.xml no longer carries a profile repository URL over cleartext.
